# 'cgra' Dialect

_An MLIR dialect for CGRA deployment_

This dialect transforms regular MLIR code to make it suitable for CGRA
accelerators. It detects max operations, non-i32 operations, and annotates
the target code. It also performs loop-level optimizations such as
unrolling, fusion, and tiling.

[TOC]

## Operations

### `cgra.deploy` (cgra::DeployOp)

_Mark a region for CGRA deployment_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `cgra.deploy` (`ins` `(` $streams^ `:` type($streams) `)`)? $body attr-dict
              (`:` type($results)^)?
```

Wraps a loop nest that is to be offloaded to the CGRA accelerator.

The `streams` operands are the memrefs the kernel reads and writes, passed to
the region as block arguments so the data flow is explicit rather than
captured. `getStreams()` is the single source of truth for the CGRA passes.

`input_args` / `output_args` / `inout_args` record which streams are read,
written, or both; `dispatch_size` is the product of the body's constant loop
bounds. All are set by `--annotate-dispatch-io`.

Traits: `SingleBlockImplicitTerminator<YieldOp>`, `SingleBlock`

#### Attributes:

<table>
<tr><th>Attribute</th><th>MLIR Type</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><code>input_args</code></td><td>::mlir::DenseI32ArrayAttr</td><td>i32 dense array attribute</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>output_args</code></td><td>::mlir::DenseI32ArrayAttr</td><td>i32 dense array attribute</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>inout_args</code></td><td>::mlir::DenseI32ArrayAttr</td><td>i32 dense array attribute</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>dispatch_size</code></td><td>::mlir::IntegerAttr</td><td>64-bit signless integer attribute</td></tr>
</table>

#### Operands:

| Operand | Description |
| :-----: | ----------- |
| `streams` | variadic of any non-token type |

### `cgra.strela_read` (cgra::StrelaReadOp)

_Volatile 32-bit MMIO read from a named STRELA register_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `cgra.strela_read` $reg (`[` $channel^ `]`)? attr-dict `:` type($value)
```

A single 32-bit volatile load from one STRELA control register (e.g.
"STRELA_STATUS"), used by the completion spin-wait. Lowers to llvm.load.

`MemRead`, not `Pure`: the value changes between reads, so it must not be
CSE'd or hoisted out of the spin-wait.

Interfaces: `MemoryEffectOpInterface (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{MemoryEffects::Read on ::mlir::SideEffects::DefaultResource}`

#### Attributes:

<table>
<tr><th>Attribute</th><th>MLIR Type</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><code>reg</code></td><td>::mlir::StringAttr</td><td>string attribute</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>channel</code></td><td>::mlir::IntegerAttr</td><td>32-bit signless integer attribute</td></tr>
</table>

#### Results:

| Result | Description |
| :----: | ----------- |
| `value` | 32-bit signless integer |



### `cgra.strela_write` (cgra::StrelaWriteOp)

_Volatile 32-bit MMIO write to a named STRELA register_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `cgra.strela_write` $reg (`[` $channel^ `]`)? `,` $value attr-dict `:` type($value)
```

A single 32-bit volatile store to one STRELA control register, named
symbolically by `reg` (e.g. "STRELA_CTRL") plus an optional `channel` for the
per-lane IMN/OMN registers. The MMIO base/offset is resolved when lowering to
llvm.store, so the register layout never appears in the IR.

`MemWrite` keeps it from being deleted as dead or reordered against the rest
of the programming sequence.

Interfaces: `MemoryEffectOpInterface (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{MemoryEffects::Write on ::mlir::SideEffects::DefaultResource}`

#### Attributes:

<table>
<tr><th>Attribute</th><th>MLIR Type</th><th>Description</th></tr>
<tr><td><code>reg</code></td><td>::mlir::StringAttr</td><td>string attribute</td></tr>
<tr><td><code>channel</code></td><td>::mlir::IntegerAttr</td><td>32-bit signless integer attribute</td></tr>
</table>

#### Operands:

| Operand | Description |
| :-----: | ----------- |
| `value` | 32-bit signless integer |



### `cgra.yield` (cgra::YieldOp)

_Terminator for a cgra.deploy region_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `cgra.yield` attr-dict ($operands^ `:` type($operands))?
```

Implicit single-block terminator of a `cgra.deploy` region. It carries the
region's optional results and is elided when it has no operands. Only valid
directly inside a `cgra.deploy`.

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`, `HasParent<DeployOp>`, `Terminator`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

#### Operands:

| Operand | Description |
| :-----: | ----------- |
| `operands` | variadic of any non-token type |
